title: LAION-5B: An open large-scale dataset for training next generation image-text models

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Q16 documentation pipeline and CLIP embeddings to identify, extract, and document the frequency of potentially inappropriate concepts within the dataset, including terms related to racism, hate, violence, and stereotypes.
Training and applying specialized EfficientNetV2 and CLIP-based classifiers to detect, measure, and tag the prevalence of pornographic and sexualized content in the dataset.
